packageRules.description: tscircuit and its packages publish several versions a day (0.0.x, each pinned exactly here because any of them can move a pad or redraw a picture). One PR a week is enough to stay current without a PR and a CI run for every publish. They get their own group so that a tscircuit update that changes the board pictures -- which fails the snapshot step in CI and therefore does not merge itself -- does not hold back the other dependencies.
